policy: Preserve PREOS G0-G11 as stable assurance super-gates. Rename the attached framework G0-G17 to R0-R17 readiness sub-gates to avoid identifier collision and breaking changes.

gates.name: Scope and criticality
gates.acceptance: Product scope, users, markets, criticality, data sensitivity, and risk class approved.

gates.name: Requirements and traceability
gates.acceptance: Critical functional and nonfunctional requirements have measurable acceptance criteria and evidence paths.

gates.name: Architecture and AI governance
gates.acceptance: Current architecture, threat model, AI tool permissions, human approvals, and change ownership are established.

gates.name: Security architecture
gates.acceptance: Security controls and privileged paths are designed and reviewed before final release testing.

gates.name: Privacy and data lifecycle
gates.acceptance: Actual data handling is mapped, minimised, lawful where required, and operationally supportable.

gates.name: Legal documentation
gates.acceptance: Terms, Privacy Policy, notices, permissions, and product claims match actual behaviour.

gates.name: Compliance and jurisdiction
gates.acceptance: Applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, marketplace, and sector obligations are mapped and satisfied.

gates.name: Supply chain
gates.acceptance: Dependencies, SDKs, APIs, licences, provenance, and critical third parties pass review.

gates.name: Functional and security testing
gates.acceptance: Critical workflows and application security controls pass required test suites.

gates.name: Data and migration
gates.acceptance: Integrity, transactions, schema changes, migration, reconciliation, and rollback or recovery are verified.

gates.name: Performance and scalability
gates.acceptance: Expected peak and stress conditions meet performance, error, and cost thresholds.

gates.name: Reliability and recovery
gates.acceptance: Failure, backup, restoration, disaster recovery, and resilience objectives are demonstrated.

gates.name: UX and accessibility
gates.acceptance: Critical journeys are usable and accessible for intended users.

gates.name: Release and rollback
gates.acceptance: Production deployment, approval, observability, feature rollout, and rollback procedures are proven.

gates.name: Operations and support
gates.acceptance: Monitoring, alerts, incident response, support, ownership, and runbooks are operational.

gates.name: Payments and distribution
gates.acceptance: Payment, billing, app store, marketplace, and distribution controls pass where applicable.

gates.name: Residual risk acceptance
gates.acceptance: Open risks are explicitly owned, time bounded where possible, and accepted by the correct authority.

gates.name: Production authorisation
gates.acceptance: All blockers are cleared and accountable authority signs the production release decision.
